title: Recurrence and range of the balanced excited random walk M(2,1,2)
summary: We prove that the planar balanced excited random walk $M(2,1,2)$ is recurrent. This walk takes a horizontal simple random walk step on its first departure from each vertex and a planar simple random walk step on every later departure. Moreover, the number of distinct vertices visited before time $n$, multiplied by $(\log n)/n$, converges to $π$ almost surely and in every $L^p$, $1\le p<\infty$, the same limit as for the planar simple random walk.
